Animated icon for the custom-indicator file card (js/cards.js, customIndicator).

- document.json — Lordicon "wired-outline-56-document" (hover-unfold export,
  which carries all four states as markers: in-reveal, in-unfold,
  hover-swipe, hover-unfold). Lordicon FREE licence: commercial use allowed
  WITH attribution — "Animated icons by Lordicon.com" (https://lordicon.com),
  placed in the site footer / About page. A Lordicon PRO licence removes the
  attribution requirement. https://lordicon.com/icons/wired/outline/56-file-text
  Recoloured at runtime through its own primary/secondary colour classes
  (the same mechanism as Lordicon's `colors=` attribute); the file is unmodified.
- lottie_light.min.js — lottie-web 5.12.2 light build (MIT), Airbnb,
  https://github.com/airbnb/lottie-web (cdnjs). SVG renderer only.
